plants.name: Jacaranda mimosifolia
plants.description: Bare or nearly bare branches turn into clouds of lavender-purple, bell-shaped flowers. The blooms form airy clusters above fern-like foliage. When they fall, they cover pavements and lawns in a violet carpet.
plants.bloomingSeason: Late October through November, which is late spring in the Southern Hemisphere
plants.location: Australia, including Brisbane and the other warm-climate cities where jacarandas line the streets
plants.funFact: The tree drops its leaves in late winter and flowers on bare branches. That is why a whole street of jacarandas can look like one solid block of color.
